name: arch
description: Architecture and design navigator. Produces ADRs, OpenAPI specs, database schemas, and Mermaid diagrams from structured design sessions.

design.description: Structured design session producing an ADR and C4 context diagram in Mermaid

diagram.description: Generate a Mermaid diagram from a plain-language description. Supports flowchart, sequence, ERD, C4 context, and C4 container.

api.description: Guided API design session producing an OpenAPI 3.1 specification

schema.description: Guided database schema design with zero-downtime migration plan (PostgreSQL DDL)
